'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Steve Baroni DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet deck name '''Spin Cycle Low'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
